name: Delighted Halfling
oracle_text:
{T}: Add {C}.
{T}: Add one mana of any color. Spend this mana only to cast a legendary spell, and that spell can't be countered.
blocked_sentences: {T}: Add one mana of any color. Spend this mana only to cast a legendary spell, and that spell can't be countered.

needs.what: a rider on a restricted mana ability -- e.g. `uncounterable: true` beside `mana_restriction` -- that travels with the mana: a spell any of whose cost was paid with mana from that ability can't be countered. The produced mana must carry the tag through `costs`/`mana` payment into the stack item, and `ops_stack.op_counter` must consult the stack item's paid-with tag alongside the printed `uncounterable` flag and the `spells_cant_be_countered` static
needs.why_existing_wont_do: Uncounterable-ness has exactly two spellings, and neither is conditional on how a spell was paid for. The card-level `uncounterable` boolean (src/automtg/cards/schema.py:759 -> src/automtg/engine/carddef.py:919) is read off the spell's own registry definition by `op_counter` (src/automtg/engine/effects/ops_stack.py:387) -- one card saying it about itself, ungrantable, and it is the wrong card here: the Halfling is not the spell. The `spells_cant_be_countered` static (`_shielded_by_a_static`, ops_stack.py:264) can cover *other* spells and its optional `affects_spells` filter reads printed characteristics, so `{"supertypes": ["Legendary"]}` would load -- and it is a strictly better and differently-worded card: it would protect every legendary spell on the table, including opponents' and including ones cast with no Halfling mana at all, for as long as the Halfling is on the battlefield, where the printed line protects only the one spell this particular mana helped cast. It is also not sayable as written: the clause is the tail of the mana ability's printed sentence, and a separate static would have to claim a printed line the card does not have, which the residual gate rejects. Nothing joins the two: `Payment`/`ManaSource` (src/automtg/engine/mana.py:847) carry a `ManaRestriction` that only *filters which sources may pay*, with no channel back to the resulting stack item, and the mana-ability rider ops (MANA_RIDER_OPS = add_counters, add_poison, damage, gain_life, lose_life, remove_counters) are all on-activation effects that cannot touch a spell cast later.
